questions.question: Write the passive form of the sentence:We do not like idle people.
options: Idle people are not of our liking.
Idle people were not liked by us.
We are not liked by idle people.
Idle people are not liked by us.
questions.explanation: Answer: D) Idle people are not liked by us.

questions.question: Identify the passive sentence from the following sentences:
options: The cleaner cleaned the room.
Somebody stole my pen.
Honey tastes sweet.
The building is being built.
questions.explanation: Answer: D) The building is being built.

questions.question: The correct passive of the sentence:Sheila was writing a letter.
options: A letter is being written by Sheila.
Writing a letter is being done by Sheila.
A letter was written by Sheila
A letter was being written by Sheila.
questions.explanation: Answer: D) A letter was being written by Sheila.

questions.question: Rice Sells Cheap is-
options: Passive Voice
Active voice
Both
None
questions.explanation: Answer: b) Active Voice

questions.question: Choose the Passive form of the sentence "Pluck me a flower."
options: Let a flower be plucked by me.
Let a flower plucked for me.
Let a flower be plucked for me
Let me pluck a flower.
questions.explanation: Answer:C) Let a Flower be plucked for me.

questions.question: He helped me do it.The Passive Voice of the statement is:
options: It was done by him to help me
It was to help me by him doing it.
I was helped by him to do it.
I was helped by him do it.
questions.explanation: Answer: C) I was helped by him to do it.Help+ base form থাকলে passive এ পরবর্তি verb এর পূর্বে to বসে।  (to+base ফর্ম)

questions.question: Change the voice of the Following sentence:He is thought to be a teacher.
options: We thought him to be a teacher
We think he is a teacher
We think him to be a teacher
We thought him a teacher.
questions.explanation: Ans: C) We think him to be a teacher.Acknowledge, Assume, belief, Claim, Estimate, Feel, Find, Know, Presume, Report Think Understand etc. Verb গুলোর active থেকে passive form এ নিতে হলে:Indirect Object(ব্যক্তি বাচক) + be verb+ V3+to be+direct object( He is thought to be a teacher (by us))~Passive

questions.question: It is time to shut up the shop. The passive form is:
options: It is time for the shop to be shut up.
It is time to be shut up the shop.
Time to shut up the shop it is.
It is time the shop be shut up.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) It's Time for the shop to be shut up.

questions.question: Choose the correct Passive form of the sentence: Iron Feels Hard.
options: Iron is hard when it is filled.
Iron is felt hard to me.
Iron is hard when it is felt.
Iron is hard by it is felt.
questions.explanation: Ans: C)Iron is hard when it is felt.

questions.question: The Passive form of the sentence: "Do it as I say."
options: Let it be done as it is said by me.
Let it be done as I say.
Be it done as it is said.
It should be done as I say
questions.explanation: Ans: B) Let it be done as I say.

questions.question: The correct active voice of "That house has not been lived in for years."
options: No one has been living in that house for years.
No one ever lived in that house for years.
Nobody has for years lived in that house.
Nobody had been living in that house for years.
questions.explanation: Ans:C) Nobody has for years lived in that house.

questions.question: I shall be obliged to go.  (Change the voice)
options: Obligation will make me go.
It will oblige me to go.
It will be within my obligation to go.
Circumstances will oblige me to go.
questions.explanation: Ans:D) Circumstances will oblige me to go.

questions.question: He decided to sell the house. The best Passive will be-
options: It was decided by him to sell the house.
He decided that the house shall be sold.
He decided that the house is sold.
He decided that the house is selling.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) It was decided by him to sell the house. Another Correct Passive: He decided that the house should be sold.Passive: {Subject+ Verb (অপরিবর্তিত)}+ that + Object+ Should be + infinitive এর verb er V3।Or,শুরুতে it বসিয়ে passive করা।

questions.question: He died of fever.  The best Passive will be-
options: Fever caused him to die.
Fever caused his death.
He was caused to die of fever.
His death was caused by fever.
questions.explanation: Ans: C) He was caused to die of fever.ব্যতিক্রম Rules Nai ❌.

questions.question: He worked for an hour. The best Passive will be-
options: An hour was worked for by him.
An hour was passed by him in the work.
He was in the work for an hour.
An hour was spent by him in working.
questions.explanation: Ans: D) An hour was spent by him in working.ব্যতিক্রম Rules Nai ❌.

questions.question: I have a cat Make it passive -
options: A cat is had by me.
A cat is being had by me.
A cat have been had by me.
A cat is has been had by me
questions.explanation: Ans:A) A cat is had by me.ব্যতিক্রম Rules Nai ❌.

questions.question: The Passive form of "I don't like people telling me what to do."
options: I don't like being told what to do.
I don't like people being told what to do
I don't like people are told what to do
People who tell me what to do are not liked by me.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) I don't like being told what to do.

questions.question: He suggested that smoking should be given up. The Active form of the sentence:
options: He suggested giving up smoking.
He has suggested giving up smoking
He had suggested giving up smoking
None of these.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) He suggested giving up smoking.

questions.question: The Passive form of "I am sorry to disturb you."
options: I am sorry to be disturbed by you.
You are sorry to be disturbed by me.
I am sorry to have disturbed you.
I am disturbed by your sorrow.
questions.explanation: Ans: C) I am sorry to have disturbed you.

questions.question: The correct passive form of the sentence: "I saw him fall from the tree." is
options: He was seen by me to fall from the tree.
The tree was seen to fall by me.
He was seen to fall from the tree by me.
He was seen falling from the tree by me.
questions.explanation: Ans: D) He was seen falling from the tree by me.

questions.question: The passive form of the sentence: "His sudden death shocked me."
options: I was shocked by his sudden death.
His sudden death was shocking.
I was shocked to his death.
I was shocked at his sudden death.
questions.explanation: Ans: D) I was shocked at his sudden death.

questions.question: The Unfed should be fed. (Active).
options: Feed the Unfed.
Please let the Unfed be fed.
We should fed the unfed.
We should feed the unfed.
questions.explanation: Ans: D) We should feed the unfed.

questions.question: I helped her solve the problem. (Passive).
options: She was helped to solve the problem.
The problem was solved by me.
The problem was solved by her with my help.
She was helped to solve the problem by me.
questions.explanation: Ans: D) She was helped by me to solve the problem.⁉️⁉️Subject: IVerb: helped‼️Indirect Object: her (the person who is receiving help)‼️Direct Object: the problem (the thing that is being solved) ⭕ Indirect object becomes the subject.

questions.question: Do you know him? বাক্যটির (Passive form):
options: Is he known by you?
Is he known to you?
Is he known with you?
Does he known by you?
questions.explanation: Ans: B) Is he known to you?

questions.question: The correct Passive form of the sentence "They Laugh at us."
options: We are laugh at them.
We are laughed by them.
We are laughed at by them.
We are laughed at with them.
questions.explanation: Ans: C) We are laughed at by them.

questions.question: The Passive form of the sentence "We made her recite a poem."
options: A poem was made to be recited by her.
She was made to recite a poem.
She was forced to recite a poem.
A poem was made to be recited.
questions.explanation: Ans: B) She was made to recite a poem.

questions.question: The Passive form of the sentence "Do not take the forget me not."
options: Forget me not be taken by you.
Let not the forget me not be taken by you.
Let never taken the forget-me-not.
Let's not taken by you the forget me not.
questions.explanation: Ans: B) Let not the (forget me not) be taken by you.‼️“Forget-me-not” is a type of flower 🌹.The sentence means: Do not pick or remove the flower..🙂

questions.question: The teacher will be teaching us. বাক্যটির passive form হবে?
options: We will be being taught by the teacher.
We should be being taught by the teacher.
We shall be taught by the teacher.
We will be taught by the teacher.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) We will be being taught by the teacher.

questions.question: Nishat apu teaches us English. The Passive form will be...
options: English is taught to us by Nishat Apu.
We are taught English by Nishat Apu.
English is teaching us by Nishat Apu
Nishat Apu was taught English by us.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) We are taught English by Nishat Apu.Subject: Nishat Apu Verb: taught⁉️Indirect Object: us (the people receiving the teaching)⁉️Direct Object: English (the thing being taught)♨️Make the indirect object (us) the subject.

questions.question: Kindly grant me two days leave. Change the voice.
options: May I kindly be granted two days leave?
Let me be granted two days' leave.
Let two days leave be granted to me.
Two days leave is requested to me.
questions.explanation: Ans: A) May I be granted two days of leave?♨️ Imperative sentence এ May I দিয়ে passive করা যায়।

questions.question: Put up a tent here. Change the voice.
options: Let a tent be put up here.
Have a tent put up here.
You are requested to put up a tent here.
Tent be put up here.
questions.explanation: ✅Ans: Have a tent put up here.♨️Imperative sentence এ put up/ spread থাকলে let এর পরিবর্তে have বসে।

questions.question: Which of the following sentences is in active voice?
options: Let a tent be put up here.
America was discovered by Columbus.
The meeting was postponed.
They built the bridge in six months.
questions.explanation: Answer: They built the bridge in six months.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a passive voice sentence?
options: The movie was being filmed in Canada.
He had been given a warning.
She had given him a warning.
I am being watched by him.
questions.explanation: Answer: C) She had given him a warning.

questions.question: "Whom does he love?" Choose the Passive form of the sentence:
options: Who is loved by him?
Who was loved by him
Who loves him
Who had he loved?
questions.explanation: Answer: A) Who is loved by him?

questions.question: Which of these is an example of passive voice used for a scientific process?
options: We use acid to neutralize the base.
The base is neutralized by the acid.
The students mixed the solution.
The professor gave an example of reaction.
questions.explanation: Answer: B) The base is neutralized by the acid.

questions.question: Change to passive: “Someone is knocking at the door.”
options: The door is knocked by someone.
The door has been knocked.
The door is being knocked at.
The door was being knocked.
questions.explanation: ✅ Answer: CExplanation: Present continuous → is being + past participle; “at” stays at the end.

questions.question: Change to passive: “They will have completed the project by next week.”
options: The project will have been completed by next week.
The project is completed by next week.
The project will complete by next week.
The project has been completed by next week.
questions.explanation: ✅ Answer: AExplanation: Future perfect → will have been + past participle.

questions.question: Change to passive: “She fanned herself."
options: She is fanned by herself.
Someone is fanning her
Herself was being fanned by her.
She was fanned by herself.
questions.explanation: ✅ Answer:D) She was fanned by herself.♨️Reflexive pronoun (himself, herself, myself, themselves, ourselves etc.) কখনো Subject হয় না । ⭕ Active voice হতে Passive voice করার সময় Subject এবং object এর অবস্থান অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

questions.question: Change to passive: "Let us go, you and I."
options: Let you and I be gone.
Let we be gone.
Let us go.
None of the above.
questions.explanation: ✅ Answer: ALet you and I be gone.

questions.question: Change to passive: "Friends help each other."
options: Friends are being helped by eachother.
One Friend is being helped by other friends.
Friends are helped by each other.
Friend should be helpful to eachother.
questions.explanation: ✅ Answer: C♨️ Reciprocal pronoun যুক্ত active voice থেকে passive করার সময়ে subject-object  এর অবস্থান অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।
